SELECT m.id, m.name, m.category, m.status, m.qty_warehouse AS warehouse, m.qty_bayuquan AS bayuquan, m.qty_xinmin AS xinmin, m.qty_total AS total FROM material m
ORDER BY m.id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(m.qty_warehouse), 0) AS warehouse, COALESCE(SUM(m.qty_bayuquan), 0) AS bayuquan, COALESCE(SUM(m.qty_xinmin), 0) AS xinmin, COALESCE(SUM(m.qty_total), 0) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(m.qty_total <= 0), 0) AS lowStock FROM material m

SELECT m.id, m.name, m.cost_price AS costPrice, m.sale_price AS salePrice, m.points, m.category, m.status FROM material m
ORDER BY m.id ASC

SELECT m.id, m.name, m.price, m.points, m.category, m.status FROM incidental m
ORDER BY m.id ASC
SELECT category FROM material WHERE source IN ('校宝教材设置', '本地录入') AND category IS NOT NULL AND category != '' GROUP BY category ORDER BY MIN(id)

SELECT c.id, c.room_name AS roomName, c.material_name AS materialName, c.biz_type AS bizType, c.quantity, c.unit_price AS unitPrice, CONCAT(YEAR(c.change_date), '-', MONTH(c.change_date), '-', DAY(c.change_date)) AS changeDate, c.handler, c.student_name AS studentName, c.ext_order_no AS extOrderNo, c.remark FROM material_stock_change c
ORDER BY c.change_date DESC, c.seq ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.quantity > 0 THEN c.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inSum, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.quantity < 0 THEN -c.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outSum, COALESCE(SUM(c.quantity), 0) AS total FROM material_stock_change c
SELECT room_name FROM material_stock_change WHERE source IN ('校宝库存变动', '本地录入') GROUP BY room_name ORDER BY MIN(id)
SELECT material_name FROM material_stock_change WHERE source IN ('校宝库存变动', '本地录入') GROUP BY material_name ORDER BY MIN(id)
